artworks.title: Reynard Attempts to Pilfer a Rooster
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a variety of elements. A line of trees and a building mark the horizon, along with a church steeple in the distance. The detailed etching style includes cross-hatched and linear strokes, giving texture and depth to the scene. The monochromatic palette varies between light and dark tones to create contrast. A fox interacts with a large bird, possibly a rooster, while another dog looks on. Nearby, a group of poultry wanders by a stone wall with an arched window. Further back, two figures are next to a cart filled with hay, partially hidden by trees. The scene is richly detailed, capturing various activities and characters in a rural setting.

artworks.title: The Animals Present Their Charges Against Reynard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of animals gathered in a natural setting. The scene features a variety of animals including a lion at the center, surrounded by a cheetah, a goat, a fox, a sheep, a hare, and a rooster. The animals are depicted in a harmonious group. The background shows trees and clouds, rendered in fine detail. The line work is intricate with hatchings and cross-hatchings to suggest texture and shadow, in the style reminiscent of classic European printmaking art.

artworks.title: Reynard Condemned
artworks.description: The image features a grouping of animals on a plain, with a variety of animals interacting. A horizon with an old stone tower and rural buildings is visible in the upper quarter. Mountains are seen in the far distance. The animals, landscape, and foliage are depicted using intricate lines, showing detailed textures. The color scheme is monochrome on tan paper. Trees frame the scene.

artworks.title: Reynard's Relatives Plead for Him
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of wild animals in a natural setting. The image depicts a variety of animals including wolves, a fox, a leopard, a lion, and a lioness, all appearing to interact with one another in a forested landscape. The scene is richly detailed with intricately crafted foliage comprising the trees that frame the image. The composition uses a balance of light and shadow to highlight the textures of the animals' fur and the leaves. The bark of the trees and the mountainous backdrop add depth to the wilderness setting, creating a harmonious depiction of wildlife coexisting in their natural environment.

artworks.title: Reynard Asks Permission to Speak
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals gathered in a forest setting. The illustration features a variety of animals depicted with human-like expressions and postures. Prominently featured is a lion holding a staff, surrounded by foxes, a leopard, a badger, a rooster, and other woodland creatures. Some animals are standing in an attentive manner as if engaged in a council or meeting. A fox can be seen hanging from a branch, while another rests on a tree limb. The background is dense with trees, creating a lush, forested setting. The use of intricate line work and detailed shading illustrates the animals and scenery with a textured, lively feel.

artworks.title: Reynard is Released to Tell His Story
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals gathered in a natural setting. The scene includes a bear, a lion, a leopard, a wolf, a goat, and a few other animals together under the shade of lush trees. The background shows distant mountain peaks. The drawing has intricate line work depicting the textures of the animals' fur and the foliage. The setting portrays a peaceful moment among the animals. The composition captures a harmonious moment in nature.

artworks.title: Reynard Winds His Tale and Wrongs His Father
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals in a woodland setting. The scene depicts a collection of animals gathered around a fallen tree in a forest. In the foreground, there is a lion, a spotted cat resembling a leopard, and a fox. A hare sits among the branches, and to the right, a bear is seen. An additional creature, possibly a weasel, appears at the very edge of the right side. In the background, there is a figure partially obscured on the tree trunk. A bird is perched on one of the tree branches overhead. The cross-hatching technique and use of line work emphasize the texture of the animals' fur and the foliage of the trees.

artworks.title: Reynard in Council with the Lion and Lioness
artworks.description: The image shows a lion lying with its eyes closed next to a fox under a large tree. Nearby, there are sheep and more foxes, some resting and some standing. In the background, there is a church with spires and mountains. The scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette of black and cream, with detailed textures and contrasts. Different densities of ink suggest shadows and light.

artworks.title: Reynard Tells a Story of Hidden Treasure
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of animals in a forest setting. The image depicts different animals, such as a monkey, a fox-like creature, a bear, and a lion, gathered in a natural environment with detailed foliage and textured ground. The forest in the background is shown with intricate leaf patterns and tree textures. The animals are arranged together, indicating a scene where they are focused in a similar direction. The linework and shading vary across the drawing, adding depth and detail to the fur and foliage.

artworks.title: Reynard Promises to Reveal the Hidden Treasure
artworks.description: The image shows a wolf on the left, a lion and a lioness on the right, surrounded by rocks and trees. In the background, there is a view of a castle-like structure with steeples. The animals and environment are depicted in a detailed etching style with cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic using black and brown ink on a tan background. Mountains are subtly drawn in the distance, along with a sky sketched with light lines indicating clouds.

artworks.title: The Lion Pardons Reynard before the Other Animals
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of animals in a natural setting. In the scene, a group of animals are gathered together in a forest landscape. A male lion with a thick mane stands on a rocky ledge, looking down at a diverse assembly of animals below. Among the animals are a bear, several foxes, and a large rabbit, surrounded by foliage. The background features detailed trees with dense leaves and branches. The drawing uses a cross-hatched shading technique.

artworks.title: Reynard's Enemies are Dismayed
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals gathered in a natural setting. The composition features a lion prominently positioned on a small elevation. Surrounding the lion are other animals including a ram, a fox, a bear, and a bird. The scene is set within an outdoors environment, with rugged terrain and foliage. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and shading, giving texture to the fur of the animals and the leaves of the trees. The background includes a mountain or hilly landscape.

artworks.title: The Bear and the Wolf are Persecuted
artworks.description: The image shows anthropomorphic animals gathered in a wooded area with a distant castle in the background. The animals, including a bear and several fox-like creatures, are engaged in a communal activity around a tree. The scene is detailed, with intricate foliage on the tree and fur textures on the animals. A castle sits on a hill in the distance. The illustration features cross-hatching and line work to depict movement and liveliness among the creatures.

artworks.title: The Ram Blesses Reynard
artworks.description: The image shows multiple animals in a landscape. The animals include a fox, a ram, a rooster, a rabbit, and sheep. They are set against hills, trees, and a castle. The drawing is in a classical style with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The animals and landscape are detailed, creating a pastoral scene.

artworks.title: Reynard Returns Home, Accompanied by the Ram and the Rabbit
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with animals and a landscape. A ram is prominently depicted standing facing right, with two other animals grazing nearby. A large, gnarled tree is present. A shepherd's staff and a piece of cloth are placed on the ground. In the background, there are faint outlines of trees and structures. The etching style features hash-like strokes for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black lines on tan paper. The overall atmosphere is timeless and tranquil.

artworks.title: Reynard Asks the Ram to Deliver a Document
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a man on horseback and a dog nearby. The scene includes a castle, a smaller building, a tree, and clouds in the sky. The artwork uses detailed brushstrokes with a cross-hatching technique to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochrome, primarily in black and off-white tones, giving a classic appearance.

artworks.title: The Document is Opened, Revealing the Murdered Rabbit's Head
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several animals gathered in a forest scene. The drawing depicts a variety of animals including a fox, sheep, bear, leopard, lion, goat, monkey, and a dog. The animals appear to be in a council-like setting amidst trees, shrubs, and a canopy of branches and leaves overhead. In the background, there are clouds and a structure. The detailed cross-hatching and line style create a textured composition, showcasing the animals in a harmonious assembly.

artworks.title: The Lion Frees the Bear and the Wolf
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a bear, a wolf, and a lion standing together. The bear is walking ahead, while the wolf and lion are behind it. In the background, there are lightly sketched trees. The image is intricately detailed, with fine lines depicting the animals' fur and tree leaves. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and black ink on paper.

artworks.title: All Rejoice for the Bear and the Wolf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of anthropomorphic animals gathered in a woodland scene. The drawing features a bear, a fox, a goat, and a hare gathered together under a tree. Each animal is depicted with human-like qualities, such as standing on their hind legs and interacting with each other. The bear has its arms raised, while the fox and other animals gather around. To the left, an animal resembling a fox is playing a wind instrument. The background features a tree with large branches and leaves, providing a natural woodland setting for this illustration.

artworks.title: Reynard and the Crows
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape with a low horizon line. A church spire is visible in the distance above trees. Two birds are flying in the air. The brushstrokes show detailed textures in the birds' feathers and tree foliage. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of brown and black. A carcass is on the ground, and a cart is visible in the distance. Clouds are portrayed in the background.

artworks.title: The Lion Orders a Mass Assault on Reynard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various animals gathered in a natural setting. The scene features a lion, a bear, a monkey climbing a tree, a goat, a rabbit, and other smaller creatures such as a fox and a badger. The animals are intricately detailed and occupy different positions across the drawing. The background includes trees with dense foliage and a glimpse of faraway landscapes. The artist employs fine lines and shading techniques to give texture and dimension to the animals and their surroundings.

artworks.title: The Badger Goes to Warn Reynard
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with three foxes and a bird. The fox closest to us holds a bird in its mouth, facing towards the center of the image. Another fox is lying to the right, partially hidden among foliage, while a third fox sits on a hill gazing forward. The background is filled with trees, foliage, and distant mountain silhouettes. The artwork is created using intricate, cross-hatched lines, giving a textured look. The color palette is monochromatic in sepia tones, creating an antique visual effect. Branches of trees create a canopy effect at the top of the image, framing the scene.

artworks.title: The Mare and the Wolf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring horses, wolves, and a church. The image shows an interaction between the horses and wolves in a natural setting. On the right side, a horse is standing on its hind legs near a wolf on the ground. On the left side, another horse is also on its hind legs. A wolf is perched on a rock observing the scene. In the background, there is a church with a steeple among trees and rustic structures. The drawing is detailed with fine lines, capturing movement and tension in a rural setting.

artworks.title: Reynard Attempts to Clear Himself
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of animals gathered in a forest setting. The composition includes a variety of animals prominently featuring a lion resting in the center, surrounded by a bear, a wolf, and several other smaller creatures such as a sheep, a rooster, a rabbit, and a cat. The landscape is lush with detailed foliage, trees, and a mountainous backdrop. The artist has employed fine lines and hatching to convey texture and depth.
